_doc: Tier/tag constraints over the generated census. Selectors: a tree name, `tag:stub|weak|cleave|periphery`, or `*`. `source` matches the caller; `forbid` names targets that may not be reached; `allow_source` names callers that are permitted to reach a forbidden target. Edit deliberately: every entry here should be a decision, and `boundary_policy.py --selftest` must stay green.

constraints.name: nothing depends on a stub
constraints.why: a D-stub tree is data with no defs that nothing imports; a real edge into one means it is not a stub and should be re-tiered instead of exempted

constraints.name: only drivers reach the periphery
constraints.why: the 4 @periphery edges are launchers in TOOLS calling repo-root scripts they do not own; a library or report tree reaching out of src is coupling the shards cannot shard
